text: Step Note 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端插件，为启用的工具调用添加模型生成的一句话步骤说明，并把说明显示在聊天步骤行及可选的工具卡片中。它在系统提示组装时调整模型可见的工具参数 schema，并提供设置页面管理总开关、必填规则、语言、提示词和工具卡片替换。可按工具单独启用、改写提示词或覆盖必填状态，也能配置 read、write、edit 等工具的说明卡片。适合想快速看懂模型正在执行何种工具步骤的网页端用户；不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

Step Note adds model-written notes to enabled tool calls and shows them in chat steps or optional tool cards. Its web settings control tools, languages, prompts, and required notes. Users can customize prompts and cards per tool. No API key or external service is needed.
想让聊天里的工具调用显示一句正在做什么的说明。
有没有办法看懂模型调用 read、write 或 bash 时在处理哪一步？
我希望模型每次执行工具前都写一句简短目的。
想按工具分别设置步骤说明的提示词，并在界面里常驻显示。
How can I show a short explanation for each tool call in chat?
I want to customize the model prompt for tool-step descriptions per tool.
为启用的工具在模型可见的参数 schema 中加入 description 字符串字段，可配置为必填并保留或覆盖工具原有提示词；根参数禁止额外字段或描述为固定值时跳过。
聊天步骤行读取工具调用的 description 并作为摘要显示；在工具卡片替换启用时，可在执行结果卡片上保留说明及路径、diff 或结果文本。
设置页面提供总开关、说明必填、语言选择、全局及逐工具提示词配置，并可逐工具控制说明卡片替换和必填覆盖。
怎样让工具步骤的简短描述也出现在执行完成后的卡片上？
Can I make tool notes required only for selected tools?
@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Introduction：<div align="center">

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Step Note：简体中文 | [English](./README.en.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note) [](LICENSE) [](https://nodejs.org) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 给 DeepSeek Harness 的工具加一句由模型填写的步骤说明，让你看懂模型现在正在做什么。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 功能特性：- **为工具调用添加描述字段**：启用的工具会多一个由模型填写的 `description`，显示为对话里的步骤说明和工具卡片。
- **支持自定义描述字段的提示词**：可以按语言、按工具覆盖这句描述的提示词。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 从 npm 安装：需要 Node.js ≥ 22.19（或 ≥ 24）和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x（≥ 0.2.1）。

**网页版**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note
dsh web
```

**桌面端**

1. 侧边栏打开「**插件**」，点「**添加插件**」→「**安装第三方插件**」。
2. 填入 `@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note`，点「**安装**」。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

安装后，设置页会出现「**工具步骤说明**」。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 试一下：在标准模式下发送下面这句，可以触发多个工具：

```text
帮我做一次项目体检：读一下 package.json、tsconfig 和 tsdown.config.ts，搜一下还有没有遗留的 TODO，然后跑一次 pnpm build。只做检查，不要改文件，最后把结果告诉我。
```

测试 run_code 卡片：切到 PTC 模式，让它打印 1+1。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 基本设置：- **启用步骤说明**：总开关。
- **设为必填**：默认关闭；打开后，没有单独设置的工具都要求模型必须填写步骤说明。每个工具可以在「工具」页单独覆盖。
- **默认提示词语言**：自动跟随界面语言，也可以固定为中文或英文；留空的提示词按所选语言处理。
- **步骤说明提示词**：没有单独提示词、也没有自带描述的工具用它。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 工具：默认开启：edit、read、write、bash、pwsh、grep、glob、job_list、job_output、job_kill。

每个勾选的工具有三项设置：

| 设置 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **单独设置提示词** | 整段替换这个工具的提示词；不改动时保留工具自带描述，没有自带描述的跟随所选语言 | 未勾选 |
| **必填** | 模型必须填写步骤说明 | 跟随「基本设置」，可单独覆盖 |
| **替换工具卡片** | 用插件绘制的一行卡片代替原生卡片，说明常驻；优先级必须小于 0（默认 -1000） | read、write、edit 开启 |

**默认替换 read、write、edit**：它们的原生卡片显示路径，不显示说明；不替换的话，说明只在运行中闪一下。

bash、pwsh、grep、glob 等原生卡片已经显示说明；任务、目标、计划等是结果卡片；ask_user_question、skill、present 是交互界面，所以这些保留原生卡片。替换后原生详情不会复现，但文件路径和 diff 仍在。
@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · run_code：run_code 是 PTC 模式的工具，本身就有步骤说明且始终必填，插件不会再添加第二个字段。「单独设置提示词」默认未勾选，使用内置提示词；修改后固定使用你写的文字。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · 说明：- 插件只改「模型看到的 schema」，不改工具注册时的参数校验。
- 步骤行里的说明只在工具「运行中」显示；read、write 这类很快结束的工具，默认通过替换卡片保留说明。
- 参数根声明 `additionalProperties: false` 的工具会跳过；固定过程描述（enum、const）的工具不能修改；MCP 工具可能不接受额外参数，启用前请确认对应服务允许额外字段。
- 提示词语言每次请求都会重新解析；卡片替换在保存后立即生效。

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Step Note：[简体中文](./README.md) | English [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note) [](LICENSE) [](https://nodejs.org) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) A one-line, model-written step note for every DeepSeek Harness tool call, so you can see what the model is doing right now.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Features：- **A description field for tool calls**: enabled tools get a model-written `description`, shown on the chat step row and the tool card.
- **Per-tool prompt customization**: override the prompt for that description per language and per tool.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · From npm：Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19 (or ≥ 24) and DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (≥ 0.2.1).

**Web**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note
dsh web
```

**Desktop**

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, then **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
2. Enter `@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note` and click **Install**.
3. Restart DeepSeek Harness.

After installation, **Tool Step Notes** appears in Settings.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Try it：In standard mode, send this to trigger several tools at once:

```text
Give this project a quick health check: read package.json, tsconfig and tsdown.config.ts, search for leftover TODO comments, then run pnpm build. Check only — do not change files — and report the result.
```

To see the run_code card, switch to PTC mode and ask it to print 1+1.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Basics：- **Enable step notes**: master switch.
- **Require the note**: off by default. When on, tools without their own setting must include the note; each tool can override it on the Tools tab.
- **Default prompt language**: follow the interface language automatically, or pin Chinese/English. Blank prompts follow the selected language.
- **Step note prompt**: used by tools that have no separate prompt and no description of their own.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Tools：Enabled by default: edit, read, write, bash, pwsh, grep, glob, job_list, job_output, job_kill.

Each checked tool has three settings:

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Tools：| Setting | What it does | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Use a separate prompt** | Replaces the tool's prompt as a whole; when unchecked, a tool keeps its own description and only tools without one follow the selected language | Unchecked |
| **Required** | The model must include the note | Follows the switch in Basics; override per tool |
| **Replace the tool card** | Draws the note as a compact card instead of the native one; priority must be below 0 (default -1000) | On for read, write and edit |

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Tools：**read, write and edit are replaced by default**: their native cards show a path, not the note, so without replacement the note only flashes while the tool runs.

bash, pwsh, grep and glob already show it; task, goal and plan tools are result cards; ask_user_question, skill and present are interactive UIs, so their native cards stay. The trade-off: native details are not reproduced, but file paths and diffs remain.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · run_code：run_code is a PTC-mode tool. It already has a step note and is always required, so the plugin does not add a second field. Its separate prompt is unchecked by default and uses the built-in prompt; editing it makes it use your text.

@xiaoso/dsh-tool-step-note README · Notes：- The plugin only changes the model-visible schema; it does not change a tool’s registered validation.
- The note on the step row is visible only while the tool runs. Tools that finish quickly, such as read and write, keep it by replacing their cards.
- Tools whose parameter root declares `additionalProperties: false` are skipped; tools with a fixed description (enum/const) cannot be changed; MCP tools may reject the extra argument, so confirm the server accepts it first.
- The prompt language is resolved on every request; card replacement takes effect immediately after saving.
